$comment: Knowledge-base sources (ADR-0005 iteration 6; ADR-0013 iterations 5–6). File names and titles only; the content lives in the team's Drive folder and never in git. `dir`: 'kb' = the Drive knowledgebase folder (--kb-dir), 'local' = kb/local-sources/ (git-ignored). `sourceLabel` ranks authority: 'ADA' is the authority on numbers; 'book' is for explanations and examples, never shown word for word and never the sole source of a number (ADR-0013, QST-KB-BOOK-ROLE: A). `startAt` / `endAt` (optional): regexes on the extracted text; only the text from the first startAt match up to the first endAt match is used.
